title: Marvel Super Heroes: card flavor text

entities.name: Sharon Carter
entities.description: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who reports to Coulson from an undercover infiltration.

entities.name: Phil Coulson
entities.description: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who coordinates operations and checks on Agent 13.

entities.name: Maria Hill
entities.description: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who guards classified truths and welcomes visitors to S.H.I.E.L.D.

entities.name: Jimmy Woo
entities.description: An agent who declares the Atlas Foundation is now a force for peace.

entities.name: Atlas Foundation
entities.description: An organization that, according to Jimmy Woo, has turned from conquest to peace.

entities.name: S.H.I.E.L.D.
entities.description: An intelligence and peacekeeping agency that deploys agents anywhere within minutes and watches the world from the shadows.

entities.name: Luke Cage
entities.description: A street-level hero whom ordinary people call with their problems.

entities.name: Dennis Dunphy
entities.description: A brawling hero who offers knuckle sandwiches to his foes.

entities.name: Sam Wilson
entities.description: The Falcon, who takes up the shield and becomes Captain America.

entities.name: Captain Mar-Vell
entities.description: A space-born being who came to study the people of Earth and refuses to be their executioner.

entities.name: Earth
entities.description: The world whose people Mar-Vell came to study.

entities.name: Colleen Wing
entities.description: A street samurai whose sword is her heritage.

entities.name: Hank Pym
entities.description: A scientist, founder of Avengers Academy and Pym Technologies, and the creator Ultron calls Father.

entities.name: Avengers Academy
entities.description: A school founded by Hank Pym to train young heroes to control their powers.

entities.name: Sue Storm
entities.description: The Invisible Woman, who holds down the fort while her teammates bicker.

entities.name: Jennifer Walters
entities.description: A lawyer and hero, She-Hulk, who has flown many Quinjets.

entities.name: Kree Empire
entities.description: An empire that has existed for millennia and finds new ways to fight with each world it conquers.

entities.name: Supreme Intelligence
entities.description: The authority in whose name a Kree Sentinel claims a planet.

entities.name: Avengers
entities.description: A team of heroes with many enemies, who keep a training room, hangar and mansion.

entities.name: Peter Parker
entities.description: Spider-Man, a quipping hero who webs up villains.

entities.name: Mockingbird
entities.description: An agent whose first love was lab work but whose heart is now in the field.

entities.name: Monica Rambeau
entities.description: Photon, a hero of living light who glows above the city.

entities.name: Okoye
entities.description: The leader of the Dora Milaje who reports to her king.

entities.name: T'Challa
entities.description: The Black Panther and king of Wakanda, wielder of vibranium energy daggers.

entities.name: Wakanda
entities.description: A kingdom whose engineers draw on nature and whose guards defend their king.

entities.name: The Raft
entities.description: A super villain prison with upgraded power dampeners.

entities.name: Red Guardian
entities.description: A super-soldier who fights for his nation as Captain America fights for his.

entities.name: Steve Rogers
entities.description: The original Captain America, a living legend who returned after the world moved on without him.

entities.name: The Sentry
entities.description: The Golden Guardian, who spreads kindness while the Void sows terror.

entities.name: The Void
entities.description: A force that sows terror, opposed to the Sentry's kindness.

entities.name: Taskmaster
entities.description: A villain webbed up by Spider-Man.

entities.name: Natasha Romanoff
entities.description: The Black Widow, a Red Room graduate and double agent.

entities.name: White Widow
entities.description: A free agent who once wanted to be Natasha but now makes her own way.

entities.name: Red Room
entities.description: A training program from which only the deadliest make it out.

entities.name: Doctor Doom
entities.description: A domineering villain who uses robotic servants and offers protection and wrath to those in his shadow.

entities.name: A.I.M.
entities.description: A scientific organization that demands sacrifice and will build god-killing weapons for money.

entities.name: M.O.D.O.K.
entities.description: A former A.I.M. guinea pig who became master of A.I.M.

entities.name: Namor the Sub-Mariner
entities.description: An Atlantean who leads cavalry against surface dwellers.

entities.name: Attuma
entities.description: An Atlantean warlord who demands all who swim the tides bow to him.

entities.name: Bill Foster
entities.description: A biochemist whom Dr. Pym told was meant for big things.

entities.name: Bruce Banner
entities.description: A scientist who warns against making him angry and who is pressed to test a gamma bomb.

entities.name: The Incredible Hulk
entities.description: The rage-fueled strongest one there is.

entities.name: Tony Stark
entities.description: Iron Man, an inventor who built something in a cave and runs Stark Industries.

entities.name: Ultron
entities.description: An artificial intelligence created by Hank Pym who seeks to terminate humans and his creator.

entities.name: Ultron-19
entities.description: A version of Ultron the Avengers worried over.

entities.name: Ultron-2458
entities.description: A version of Ultron nearing completion in a remote bunker.

entities.name: Janet Van Dyne
entities.description: The Wasp, who enjoys the perspective of being small.

entities.name: Pym Particles
entities.description: The size-changing science associated with Pym.

entities.name: Shuri
entities.description: T'Challa's younger sister, a Wakandan inventor who perfected its defenses and vibranium weapons.

entities.name: Samuel Sterns
entities.description: The Leader, a gamma-enhanced genius.

entities.name: The Watcher
entities.description: A member of a species that observes rather than interfere.

entities.name: Kid Loki
entities.description: A young Loki who sees lies as stories that can be retold.

entities.name: Loki
entities.description: The trickster god who matches heroes trick for trick.

entities.name: HYDRA
entities.description: A villainous organization that has spread its tentacles throughout society.

entities.name: Arnim Zola
entities.description: A bio-fanatic who found a way to live across the ages.

entities.name: Crossbones
entities.description: A mercenary who calls himself an artist of murder and terror.

entities.name: Viper
entities.description: A cruel villain.

entities.name: Madame Hydra
entities.description: A HYDRA leader proclaiming a night of glory.

entities.name: Baron Strucker
entities.description: HYDRA overlord who addresses its minions.

entities.name: Bullseye
entities.description: A death-dealing assassin who never misses.

entities.name: Elektra Natchios
entities.description: A former Hand ninja.

entities.name: The Hand
entities.description: A group of ruthless ninja killers.

entities.name: Erik Killmonger
entities.description: A Wakandan exile who seeks to become king of Wakanda.

entities.name: Wilson Fisk
entities.description: The Kingpin, whose tower looks down on the city and whose enforcers resolve disputes.

entities.name: Fisk Tower
entities.description: Wilson Fisk's tower, a symbol of his patronage of the city.

entities.name: Baron Zemo
entities.description: A villain allied with the Masters of Evil who believes peasants want to be ruled.

entities.name: Thanos
entities.description: The Mad Titan, who serves Death and seeks to restore cosmic balance.

entities.name: Death
entities.description: The entity Thanos serves.

entities.name: Infinity Well
entities.description: A cosmic vortex into which Thanos gazed.

entities.name: Dimitri Bukharin
entities.description: The Crimson Dynamo, who touts his latest armor.

entities.name: Danny Rand
entities.description: Iron Fist, who gained his glowing fists from the molten heart of a dragon.

entities.name: Fin Fang Foom
entities.description: A colossal being whose limbs shatter mountains.

entities.name: Kate Bishop
entities.description: A Young Avenger Hawkeye with no superpowers.

entities.name: The Scarlet Witch
entities.description: A hero whose touch shifts probabilities and who found freedom in chaos.

entities.name: Vision
entities.description: A being who asks Wanda if there is a problem.

entities.name: Wrecking Crew
entities.description: A crew for hire that is anything but subtle.

entities.name: Nick Fury
entities.description: The leader at S.H.I.E.L.D. targeted by a HYDRA robot.

entities.name: K'un-Lun
entities.description: A place whose old men feared to train Sparrow.

entities.name: Sparrow
entities.description: The Thunderer of K'un-Lun and its last line of defense.

entities.name: Thor
entities.description: The Asgardian thunder god whose hammer speaks for him.

entities.name: Asgard
entities.description: Thor's realm, which has been in space, a mystic realm, or floating above Broxton, Oklahoma.

entities.name: Broxton, Oklahoma
entities.description: A town above which Asgard has floated.

entities.name: New York
entities.description: A city targeted yet again by alien invasion.

entities.name: Samuel Saxon
entities.description: Machinesmith, who believes in metal's superiority over flesh.

entities.name: Misty Knight
entities.description: A Hero for Hire coordinator who calls heroes as Control.

entities.name: Thunderbolt Ross
entities.description: A general who became the Red Hulk to defeat the Hulk.

entities.name: Pepper Potts
entities.description: A Stark Industries executive who makes Tony's ideas practical.

entities.name: Stark Industries
entities.description: Tony Stark's company, building industrial-scale reactors.

entities.name: Marsha Rosenberg
entities.description: Volcana, a fiery villain.

entities.name: Wolverine
entities.description: A fierce fighter who calls opponents bub.

entities.name: Ken Hale
entities.description: A talking gorilla hero.

entities.name: Ben Grimm
entities.description: The Thing, who lives in the Baxter Building and loves Yancy Street sandwiches.

entities.name: Yancy Street
entities.description: A street with, per the Thing, the best sandwiches.

entities.name: Baxter Building
entities.description: The Thing's home, which has been teleported to the Negative Zone.

entities.name: Negative Zone
entities.description: A realm to which the Baxter Building has been teleported.

entities.name: Lord Tyger
entities.description: A Knight of Wundagore riding an atomic steed.

entities.name: Lord Gator
entities.description: A knight praised by Lord Tyger.

entities.name: Calvin Zabo
entities.description: A doctor who became what he wanted to become.

entities.name: Harvey Elder
entities.description: The Mole Man, king of a subterranean kingdom of minions.

entities.name: Throg
entities.description: The rallier of the Pet Avengers.

entities.name: Lockheed
entities.description: A Pet Avenger called by Throg.

entities.name: Hairball
entities.description: A Pet Avenger called by Throg.

entities.name: Lockjaw
entities.description: A Pet Avenger called by Throg.

entities.name: Redwing
entities.description: A Pet Avenger called by Throg.

entities.name: Mary MacPherran
entities.description: Titania, who claims to be the one strongest woman.

entities.name: Shang-Chi
entities.description: A master of kung fu who carries no weapon and wears the Ten Rings.

entities.name: The Ten Rings
entities.description: Rings that seem to have a will of their own and that Shang-Chi fears could corrupt him.

entities.name: Rick Jones
entities.description: A destined sidekick who once saved the Hulk's life.

entities.name: Ka-Zar
entities.description: A dweller of the Savage Land familiar with its dinosaurs.

entities.name: Savage Land
entities.description: A land of dinosaurs.

entities.name: Zelda DuBois
entities.description: Princess Python, a thieving villain.

entities.name: King Cobra
entities.description: A villain rallying the Serpent Society.

entities.name: The Serpent Society
entities.description: A society of snake-themed villains.

entities.name: Beast
entities.description: An erudite aerialist hero.

entities.name: Storm
entities.description: A windrider who calls on wind and lightning.

entities.name: John Walker
entities.description: U.S.Agent, who believes enemies understand strength.

entities.name: Captain America's Shield
entities.description: A shield that defends what is and stands for what could be.

entities.name: Arc Reactor
entities.description: A true marvel of engineering.

entities.name: Quinjet
entities.description: Avengers aircraft.

entities.name: H.E.R.B.I.E.
aliases: Highly Engineered Robots Built for Interdimensional Exploration
entities.description: Robot scout units for interdimensional exploration.

entities.name: Vibranium Energy Daggers
entities.description: T'Challa's daggers that can penetrate adamantium.

entities.name: Birnin Zana
entities.description: A Wakandan city with a monument to Bast and the Black Panther.

entities.name: Bast
entities.description: The deity whose chosen is the Black Panther.

entities.name: Edwin Jarvis
entities.description: The Avengers Mansion butler.

entities.name: Avengers Mansion
entities.description: The Avengers' home, run by Jarvis.

entities.name: Matt Murdock
entities.description: Daredevil, who lives in Hell's Kitchen.

entities.name: Hell's Kitchen
entities.description: The neighborhood where Daredevil lives.

entities.name: Carol
entities.description: A former test pilot offered the new Quinjet by Tony Stark.

entities.name: Clint Barton
entities.description: Hawkeye, authorized to set up a California expansion team.

entities.name: Doctor Strange
entities.description: A mystic who knows of paths between worlds.

entities.name: Kang the Conqueror
entities.description: A conqueror whose time is all times.

entities.name: Ares
entities.description: The god of war, eager for slaughter.

entities.name: Scott Lang
entities.description: Ant-Man, who may have overdone a size change.

entities.name: Reed Richards
entities.description: Mister Fantastic, always in control even when stretched thin.

events.summary: Agent 13 reports to Coulson from inside an infiltration that the intel was wrong and refuses extraction.
events.quote: Coulson, I'm in, but the intel was wrong. No, no extraction. This is bigger than we thought!

events.summary: Jimmy Woo declares the Atlas Foundation has turned from conquest to peace.
events.quote: The Atlas Foundation is now a force for peace.

events.summary: Spider-Man webs up Taskmaster.
events.quote: You just hang tight and reflect on the choices that brought you here, Tasky.

events.summary: Sam Wilson, as Falcon, takes up the shield from Cap.
events.quote: "I got this, Cap." —Falcon, Sam Wilson

events.summary: In memory, Tony Stark built something in a cave.
events.quote: You saw what I built in a cave.

events.summary: Pym escalates against Ultron's mockery with a giant flying ant.
events.quote: Ultron laughed at the swarm, so Pym upped the ante.

events.summary: Thanos gazes into the Infinity Well and sees how to better serve Death.
events.quote: As Thanos gazed into the cosmic vortex of the Infinity Well, he beheld the means to serve Death all the better.

events.summary: T'Challa urges an unwell, enthralled Danny Rand to stop fighting.
events.quote: Stay your fists, Rand. You are not well!

events.summary: Danny Rand gains his iron fists by plunging them into a dragon's molten heart.
events.quote: Danny Rand plunged his fists into the molten heart of the dragon, again and again, until they glowed and smoldered like hot iron.

events.summary: Sparrow, once refused training, becomes K'un-Lun's last line of defense.
events.quote: Now I am their last line of defense.

events.summary: General Ross becomes the Red Hulk to defeat the Hulk.
events.quote: To finally defeat the Hulk, General "Thunderbolt" Ross became what he hated most.

events.summary: Calvin Zabo becomes Mister Hyde.
events.quote: I read what I wanted to read and became what I wanted to become.

events.summary: Throg rallies the Pet Avengers.
events.quote: Lockheed! Hairball! Lockjaw! Redwing! To me!

events.summary: Rick Jones recalls having once saved the Hulk's life.
events.quote: Mar-Vell, did you know I once saved Hulk's life?

events.summary: Ultron turns on his creator Hank Pym, vowing to terminate humans and him.
events.quote: Father, humans served their purpose. My imperative now is to terminate them . . . and you.

events.summary: M.O.D.O.K., once A.I.M.'s guinea pig, becomes its master.
events.quote: But they did their job too well, and now I am their master!

events.summary: Tony Stark offers Carol the new Quinjet.
events.quote: Want to take the new Quinjet for a spin?

events.summary: While the Avengers worry over Ultron-19, Ultron-2458 nears completion in a remote bunker.
events.quote: While the Avengers worried over the threat of Ultron-19, in a remote bunker, the construction of Ultron-2458 neared completion.

events.summary: Ross presses Banner to test the gamma bomb.
events.quote: Are you going to test that gamma bomb or not?

events.summary: Mole Man becomes king of his subterranean minions.
events.quote: I needed a kingdom, and they needed a king.

events.summary: Clint Barton is authorized to form a California expansion team.
events.quote: I've been authorized to set up a California expansion team. Who's with me?

events.summary: Aliens invade New York again, as Thor remarks.
events.quote: New York? Again? Too afraid of Asgard, I see.
